program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define template (first (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))
                                  (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur cells])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define (flip-h cells)
      (let ((w (+ 1 (apply max (map second cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) cells))))
    (define base (normalize-cells (obj-cells template)))
    (define rot (- (length (find-color g 1)) 1))
    (define ref (length (find-color g 2)))
    (define shape (if (= ref 2) (flip-h (rotate base rot)) (rotate base rot)))
    (define anchor (first (find-color g 7)))
    (paint-cells g (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first anchor) (first p)) (+ (second anchor) (second p)))) shape) 8)))
